read_label_mapping: read a tab-delimited CSV file and return a label mapping dictionary with integer values
read_scene_types_mapping: read a tab-delimited scene types file and return a mapping of scene names to integer IDs
visualize_label_image: visualize a segmentation label image by coloring each label and save it to a file
visualize_instance_image: visualize an instance segmentation image by coloring each unique instance and save it to a file
create_color_palette: create and return a list of RGB color tuples for NYU40 semantic segmentation labels
